title: Word Tower
tagline: Build a tower one word at a time.
description: Enter a word beginning with the required letter before time runs out. Invalid words and timeouts eliminate the current player.
bestFor: vocabulary, quick thinking, and multiplayer word challenges.
controls: 2–8 players, either passing one device around or playing against computer opponents.
short: Build a tower of words. Each word must start with the last letter of the one before it. Last player standing wins.
about: A word-chain game for 2 to 8 players. Each word must begin with the last letter of the previous word, and every word becomes a slab in a colorful tower. Beat the timer, and be the last player standing. Play with friends on one device or against computer opponents.
saves: the tallest tower you have built
